description: Self-hosted Anytype MCP server: the full Anytype API as an always-on Docker + HTTP endpoint.

cmd.description: Publish the MCP endpoint on the host.
cmd.name: -p

cmd.description: Let the container reach the Anytype desktop app on the host. Required on Linux, harmless on macOS and Windows.
cmd.name: --add-host

name: io.github.ohneben/anytype-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Anytype API key, created in the desktop app under Settings -> API Keys.
environmentVariables.name: ANYTYPE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Port the MCP endpoint listens on, inside the container and on the host.
environmentVariables.name: PORT

environmentVariables.description: Where the Anytype desktop API is reachable from inside the container.
environmentVariables.name: ANYTYPE_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Anytype API version header sent with every request.
environmentVariables.name: ANYTYPE_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: Override the Host header sent to the Anytype API. Auto-derived when unset; Anytype rejects non-loopback hosts with 403.
environmentVariables.name: ANYTYPE_API_HOST_HEADER

environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint. Empty means open, for localhost only.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SHARED_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Compact API responses before returning them to the client. Set to false for raw payloads.
environmentVariables.name: ANYTYPE_MCP_SLIM_RESPONSES

runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP endpoint on the host.
runtimeArguments.name: -p

runtimeArguments.description: Let the container reach the Anytype desktop app on the host. Required on Linux, harmless on macOS and Windows.
runtimeArguments.name: --add-host

title: Anytype (self-hosted HTTP)
